# SalesHive

> > SalesHive is a B2B sales development agency specializing in AI-powered cold email, cold calling, and appointment setting services for lead generation.

SalesHive provides outsourced SDR services, sales development consulting, and thought leadership on modern B2B outbound strategies. The company leverages platforms like HubSpot and Salesforce, integrating AI automation and data-driven methodologies informed by research from McKinsey, Gartner, and other industry authorities.

## Key Topics

- B2B sales development
- Cold email deliverability
- Cold calling best practices
- Lead generation strategies
- Outbound sales tactics
- Email personalization
- Appointment setting
- Sales outsourcing
- AI-powered sales automation
- HubSpot and Salesforce CRM
- Email list hygiene
- SDR productivity metrics
- Pay-per-meeting models
- Sales analytics and benchmarks

## Email Marketing & Deliverability

- [B2B Email Marketing: The 2025 Playbook for Success](https://saleshive.com/blog/b2b-email-marketing-2025-playbook-success): 2025 B2B email marketing playbook covering deliverability & personalization
- [The Art of Going in Cold: How to Warm Up a Cold Email List](https://saleshive.com/blog/email-engagement-the-art-of-going-in-cold): Cold email warming techniques & deliverability best practices
- [10 Best Tactics for Email Outreach Campaigns](https://saleshive.com/blog/best-tactics-for-email-outreach-campaigns): 10 email outreach tactics: personalization, deliverability & SDR campaigns
- [Sales Analytics: Measuring B2B Email Performance](https://saleshive.com/blog/sales-b2b-analytics-measuring-email-performance): B2B cold email metrics, benchmarks & pipeline tracking analytics
- [How to Use HubSpot for B2B Email Success](https://saleshive.com/blog/b2b-use-hubspot-email-success): HubSpot email workflows, deliverability & SDR sequence optimization
- [15 Email List Building Strategies to Build Your Email Lists](https://saleshive.com/blog/15-list-building-strategies-to-build-your-email-lists): 15 B2B email list building strategies & hygiene best practices
- [The Subtle Art of Saying More with Less Words](https://saleshive.com/blog/the-subtle-art-of-saying-more-with-less-words): Cold email brevity & copywriting tactics for higher reply rates
